page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.sn2.xlarge delivers modest performance characteristics. Its single-core and multi-core CPU performance, as measured by stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25% tier. Memory bandwidth tests show a weak read-only performance of 37.94 GB/sec for large blocks, though large block write bandwidth achieves an average rating at 33.29 GB/sec. Single-threaded tasks such as gzip compression and text processing show poor performance, ranking in the bottom 10%. However, the instance maintains average performance in Passmark CPU scores and small-model LLM inference, processing 446.56 tokens per second for a 135M model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable compute resources, but the overall performance-per-resource ratio is low given the weak-to-average benchmark results. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachments. This instance is suitable for general-purpose workloads with moderate resource demands, such as basic web serving, lightweight database operations, and small-scale application hosting that do not require high-throughput memory or intensive single-threaded processing.
